contract.description: Generate a UTF-8 source FILE from selected supported blocks via PlcExternalSourceSystemGroup.GenerateSource. Requires confirm=true. block_paths limits selection; omitted selects all user blocks of the resolved PLC, which may contain unsupported graphical languages. with_dependencies defaults true; false uses GenerateOptions.None or the two-argument overload. The native method returns void and creates no PlcExternalSource project object: verify output_path and the returned file size/SHA-256, not list_external_sources. File export is not runtime acceptance.

block_paths.description: Block paths to include, e.g. from tia_openness_list_blocks; omitted generates from every user block.

confirm.description: Mutation confirmation the TIA bridge enforces: the call is refused unless this flag is true.

device_name.description: Target PLC station name; omit when the open project contains exactly one PLC.

output_path.description: Destination file path for the generated source (missing parent directories are created).

save_project.description: Persist the project to disk after this mutation. Default false: the change lives only in the running TIA Portal and is LOST if the Portal exits/crashes before a later save. Pass true at milestones (cheap) instead of batching everything to one final save.

tia_version.description: Target TIA Portal version, V16-V21 (e.g. "V20"; bare "20" also accepted). Omitted: the bridge attaches to the running portal if one is open, else the highest installed version.

with_dependencies.description: Include the blocks the selection depends on (default true when the API overload exists).

contract.name: tia_openness_generate_source_from_blocks
